sections.content: Adding -es to a noun (with the linking vowel matching vowel harmony) often creates an adjective meaning 'having/full of that quality'. szín ('colour') plus -es gives színes ('colourful').
Once szín becomes színes, it behaves like any other adjective: it goes before the noun it describes and never changes form there, e.g. 'egy színes zokni' (a colourful sock).
